'''Giorgos Lianis''' ({{langx|el|Γιώργος Λιάνης}}; born in [[Amyntaio]], 2 September 1942) is a Greek journalist ,writer and  politician 

== Biography ==
He was born on 2 September 1942 in [[Amyntaio]], [[Florina (regional unit)|Florina]]. He is a first cousin of [[Dimitra Liani]] and nephew of the professor and minister [[Georgios Lianis]] and lieutenant general Konstantinos Lianis. He studied in the Department of Chemistry of the [[Aristotle University of Thessaloniki]]. In his younger years he was a football player for [[G.S. Iraklis (Thessaloniki)|G.S. Iraklis]]<ref>[https://www.onsports.gr/podosfairo/superleague-2/story/190836/lianis-stimenos-o-ypovivasmos-toy-hrakli "Λιάνης: «Στημένος ο υποβιβασμός του Ηρακλή»" Ανακτήθηκε στις 7/9/2019]</ref> in the [[Super League Greece|Super League]].

He was a main witness in the trial of the perpetrators of the [[Greek junta|junta]] submitting important documents and recorded talks he had acquired, with evidence against [[Georgios Papadopoulos]], [[Ioannis Ladas]] and [[Dimitrios Ioannidis]].

He was elected member of parliament of Florina with [[PASOK]] in June 1989 and reelected in November 1989, 1990, 1993, 1996, 2000, 2004, 2007 and 2009. He served as Deputy Minister of Sport in the Ministry of Culture during 1993 – 1996 and 2002 – 2004.

On 14 June 2011 he left the parliamentary group of PASOK, refusing to vote the medium-term consolidation program for the Greek economy.<ref>[http://www.real.gr/DefaultArthro.aspx?page=arthro&id=74089&catID=1 real.gr] Ξεκίνησε ο «χορός» των παραιτήσεων - Ανεξαρτητοποιήθηκε ο Γ.Λιάνης (14-06-2011)</ref>
